trace.cypher:
MATCH (o:Owner)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT o
WHERE o.birth_date IS NOT NULL
WITH o,
     CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) AS birth_year,
     CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) AS birth_month,
     CAST(split_part(o.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) AS birth_day
WITH o,
     2026 - birth_year - CASE WHEN birth_month > 10 OR (birth_month = 10 AND birth_day > 14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS age
RETURN o.nationality AS col1, AVG(age) AS col2

MATCH (o:Owner)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document)
WITH DISTINCT o
WHERE o.birth_date IS NOT NULL AND o.nationality IS NOT NULL
WITH o, 2026 - CAST(regexp_extract(o.birth_date, '[0-9]{4}', 0) AS INT64) AS age
RETURN o.nationality AS col1, AVG(age) AS col2
